subject.name: Physics
subject.description: Grade 10 Physics, Semester 1 introduces the fundamental laws of motion, forces, gravity, equilibrium, and material behaviour. Students develop measurement skills, analytical thinking, and problem-solving strategies through practical examples and structured learning activities.
